summary.name: Vanna 2.0
summary.one_liner: Vanna 2.0 is a user-aware AI agent framework that connects LLMs to your database so agents can run SQL, generate charts, and use custom tools.
use_cases: Ask natural-language questions of a SQL database
Give an LLM agent controlled access to database queries
Generate charts from database results with an agent
Build an AI agent with per-user access controls
Migrate an existing Vanna 0.x project to v2
summary.what_it_does: Vanna 2.0 is presented as a Python-based agent framework that connects LLMs to databases. Developers attach tools to an LLM, such as running SQL queries, generating charts, or custom functions. Every user has access controls that apply across the system. Successful interactions are saved to Tool Memory, which the agent searches for similar past SQL queries and tool usage when a similar question is asked. The page offers quickstarts for a sample Chinook SQLite database and for connecting your own database, plus a migration guide from 0.x.
notable: Tool Memory that saves successful interactions and adapts them to later similar questions
User-scoped permissions that flow through the whole system
Includes a migration guide from Vanna 0.x
caveats: Migration is needed for users of Vanna 0.x
Pricing and licensing are not stated on this page
